summary.headline: Upatrachai and Planetary Fardars
summary.text: Astrological manuscript contents on phlebotomy, purgation, illness, recovery or death, imprisonment, and the death of the sick, followed by sections on upatrachai, chronocrators from ninth-parts according to the Indians, and Apomasar’s seven planetary fardars. Cross-references cite Florentine, Milanese, Viennese, Turin, and other codices.
